description: Defines the WebSocketEventInterface class for handling WebSocket network events, including callbacks for connection, data frames, errors, and SSL/authentication issues.

classes.name: WebSocketEventInterface
classes.description: Interface for handling WebSocket network events, including connection, data frames, errors, SSL, and authentication callbacks.

classes.name: SSLErrorCallbacks
classes.description: Nested class for handling SSL certificate error responses, with methods to cancel or continue SSL requests.

methods.name: OnCreateURLRequest
methods.description: Called when a URLRequest is created for WebSocket handshaking.

methods.name: OnAddChannelResponse
methods.description: Called when a response is received from the remote server after an AddChannelRequest.

methods.name: OnDataFrame
methods.description: Called when a data frame is received from the remote host to be forwarded to the renderer process.

methods.name: HasPendingDataFrames
methods.description: Returns true if the data pipe is full and waiting for the renderer process to read.

methods.name: OnSendDataFrameDone
methods.description: Called once for each call to SendFrame() after the frame has been passed to the OS.

methods.name: OnClosingHandshake
methods.description: Called when the remote server has started the WebSocket closing handshake.

methods.name: OnDropChannel
methods.description: Called when the WebSocket channel has been dropped due to close or error.

methods.name: OnFailChannel
methods.description: Called when the WebSocket channel fails, providing failure details.

methods.name: OnStartOpeningHandshake
methods.description: Called when the WebSocket opening handshake starts.

methods.name: OnSSLCertificateError
methods.description: Called when an SSL certificate error occurs during handshake, with callbacks to handle the error.

methods.name: OnAuthRequired
methods.description: Called when authentication is required, allowing credentials to be provided or canceled.
